name: events-check-since
description: Retro-check whether a matching event already occurred since a prior events-wait cursor. Pass sinceEventId and sinceTimestampUtc from the wait result and the same contains/marker matcher. Use to recover after a wait timed out or was cancelled. Returns all matches in the window, not just the first.

sinceEventId.description: Only return events with eventId greater than this. Use the sinceEventId returned by the prior events-wait.

sinceTimestampUtc.description: UTC timestamp returned by events-wait as startedAtUtc. Events must be newer than both this and sinceEventId.

contains.description: Match when an event's MESSAGE contains this text (case-insensitive substring). Same matcher as events-wait.

marker.description: Match an exact beacon NAME planted via the marker API (compared exactly against the event's marker field). Same matcher as events-wait.

maxEntries.description: Max number of matching events to return.

source.description: Advanced: restrict to one event origin. Defaults to any source.

type.description: Advanced: restrict to one internal event type.

level.description: Advanced: restrict by severity (e.g. Error, Warning, Log).

includeData.description: Include each event's structured data payload in the result.
